text:
Amy (People Ops): Quick check — Sam is planning to start parental leave the week of 2026-06-05 for ~10 weeks. Sam asked if we can do a combination of shift swaps and reduced-hours coverage for product reviews. Who can cover oncall chunks and async review windows? I’ll coordinate payroll/top-up and paperwork once plan is set.

Sam: Thanks! I’ll submit the formal leave request + attach the FMLA docs today. Preference is to be fully offline first 4 weeks, then 6–10 weeks intermittent check-ins (email only). Happy to do a short handoff doc.

Jordan: I can take oncall weeks 1–2 (2026-06-05 to 2026-06-19). I’m remote those weeks but available evenings. Can also pick up triage for high-priority alerts. :thumbsup:

Michelle: I can handle code & PR reviews for week 1 and week 3 (6/05–6/12 and 6/19–6/26). I’ll only review high-priority PRs, low-risk merges can be deferred.

Kiera: I can cover product review window M/W/F (async) starting 6/19 through 7/31. I can also be backup for oncall week 4 if needed.

Amy (People Ops): Awesome — can everyone confirm timezones and escalation owners? Also need to confirm payroll top-up eligibility: Sam, are you electing Redwood supplement + state leave? If you opt in, we need signed form before payroll cutoff (6/01).

Sam: Confirming — on Redwood supplement + state leave. I’ll sign and upload by EOD 5/28. Timezone PST.

Jordan: PST as well. Escalation: Jordan -> Michelle -> Eng-ops team.

Michelle: EST. I’ll add myself to the review rotation calendar and mark ‘do not assign’ for Sam on PR bot.

people-ops-bot: Leave request submitted by Sam. Request ID: LR-20260605-42. Reminder: Please attach FMLA supporting docs within 7 days.

Amy (People Ops): Drafting the handoff checklist — dropping a minimal schedule below. Please post any conflicts. If this looks ok I’ll file the coverage formally and trigger payroll forms.

```
Handoff schedule (draft):
- 2026-06-05 -> 2026-06-19: Oncall = Jordan; PR reviews = Michelle (critical only)
- 2026-06-19 -> 2026-07-03: Oncall = Jordan (backup Kiera); PR reviews = Kiera (M/W/F)
- 2026-07-03 -> 2026-07-31: Oncall = Kiera (shared); PR reviews = Kiera + Michelle (triage)
Notes: Sam offline weeks 1–4; intermittent async check-ins weeks 5–10; payroll supplement form due 2026-06-01
```

Amy (People Ops): If no objections by tomorrow 17:00 PT I’ll finalize. :calendar:
